text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: —I was having a dream.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
The first time I heard that voice
was on a radio I happened to turn on.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
—Speed Symboli. The Umamusume from Japan.
The one who vowed to "build a bridge to the world."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I heard she was going to be training
near the house I was living in.
...I went to secretly watch.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Family Grandfather
text_block_list.text: "Speed Symboli, one more lap! I know you can――"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Family Grandfather
text_block_list.text: —We can conquer the world!!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: "Strong words. Even though back then, Japan's training and race techniques were supposedly lagging behind the world."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Even so, it was understandable why
they felt compelled to speak of it like that.
Speed Symboli's legs were simply that captivating.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "And the winner of the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is—"

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: —Even if the outcome ended in crushing defeat.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
And at the invitation of the academy chairwoman back then,
I set off for Japan.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
I had never done any training before.
Yet back then, I had completely fallen in love
with Japan's potential.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
(...So when I heard about that,
I felt more shocked than happy.)

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Why the heck is Speed Symboli
going to be our coworker?!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Why is she taking a break from racing?!
She's not even injured, she can still run, so why switch to training—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Family Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
"...Because she was the one who directly challenged her,
there must be things only she understands."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Family Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
"Becoming number one in the world is a wall so high
that Japan's Umamusume must unite as one
just to have a chance to challenge it."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text: ...And the only one who can truly convey that is the one who took on the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text: She took action and bet on the future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text: Not so that I myself could win, but so that someone building upon my experience could grasp victory.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
(Speed Symboli, standing on the rooftop,
was no longer wearing the Tracen Academy uniform.)

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
(And then, she smiled at me
――as if saying, "Let's keep doing our best together.")

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...Even though you must have been the most frustrated of all.
Even though you must have burned for revenge more than anyone."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"You never once showed yourself feeling down.
You looked forward, resolute and beautiful."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sun was starting to set.
I instructed <chrname> to
begin her cool-down.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Oops,
Trainer <username> and company, is it?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: How is it? How is <chrname> doing?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
That's good.
......

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer <username>.
Do you know Speed Symboli?
choice_data_list: She's an Umamusume who challenged the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, right?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: That's right. She was the first Umamusume to fly out from Japan to take on the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
She was crazy strong, you know?
A top-class Umamusume in Japan who was named URA Horse of the Year twice.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: In the next Representative Match, could you give a performance that surpasses Speed Symboli?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...On top of that, will you
win the 'Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe' for me?"
choice_data_list: A run that surpasses Speed Symboli?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
“...Ahaha. Ah, my bad!
It's not like you can do anything even if I tell you that.”

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
There isn't even a finishing time recorded
for her Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
How on earth am I supposed to surpass that...?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
choice_data_list: We'll prove we can surpass it.
We will show you that we can surpass it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having finished her cool-down, <chrname> approaches me.
Behind her, the setting sun still blazes crimson.
